s.note: for the crew who skipped the fish
s.how: Cut 200g cheddar into cubes. Thread cubes onto toothpicks with a green grape and a cocktail onion. Lay them out in neat rows on a tray beside a row of crackers, like an old airline snack service.
Mix 200g dry-roasted peanuts and 100g almonds with a pinch of sugar and salt. Warm on a tray at 160C for 5 minutes. Cool slightly and divide into small paper packets, one for each passenger.

m.how: Sear 4 sirloins hard and rest. Crush 1 tbsp peppercorns into the pan, add 250ml cream and reduce until thick. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and milk. Steam 300g green beans. Serve on trays, airline style.

w.note: on the flight to Chicago, in a little square
w.how: Mix 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a slab tin. Beat 750g cream cheese, 200g sugar, 3 eggs and 150g sour cream. Bake in a water bath at 150C for 50 minutes. Chill overnight, cut into squares and top each with a cherry.

d.note: the coffee pot that keeps coming down the aisle
d.how: Brew 4 shots of espresso and cool for 5 minutes. Add the espresso, 160ml vodka, 80ml coffee liqueur and 20ml sugar syrup to a shaker full of ice. Shake very hard for 15 seconds to build the foam. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and float 3 coffee beans on each.
